quests.title: The Healers Are Waiting
quests.text: Our healers have patients waiting and no Glass Venom left; I would spare them having to choose who waits longest. Bring me three portions from Vine Serpents in the {name:front_skyglass_canopy/rootways}, which lie {zone_area:front_skyglass_canopy/rootways}, by day. Walk with care among those roots; I would rather not hand the healers another patient.

quests.title: Threads Across the Living Path
quests.text: Gossamer Widows draw their threads across the {name:front_skyglass_canopy/rootways} each night, until even familiar paths become snares. Kill six of them after dark. A forest must leave room for more than one kind of hunger.
quests.lesson: The same kind at night; one outing serves both.

quests.title: A Disagreement in the Branches
quests.text: I sent a scout to listen to the {name:front_skyglass_canopy/high_canopy}, which lies {zone_area:front_skyglass_canopy/high_canopy}; the Knucklers answered with a branch. Defeat six of them there by day so our watchers can return. Listening to the forest requires a little quiet, and preferably an unbroken head.
quests.lesson: The top belt of Skyglass by day.

quests.title: The Price of Another War
quests.text: I have seen this hand before, in Bough-Counter Rusk's false reckonings; in {name:paymaster_chirr}'s payroll it has grown bold, writing names from both armies in the open. A living recruit who takes this coin cannot spend or discard it; it cools only when passed on as payment for a death. Defeat five Last-Pay Archers or Ash-Writ Bowmen in all at the {name:front_skyglass_canopy/paymaster_camp}, {dir_from_giver:front_skyglass_canopy/paymaster_camp}, where they guard the pay day and night. Kill Chirr too, before he buys another generation beneath these branches.
quests.lesson: Front climax and the main line's chapter 3 climax: the last named normal leader before 60.

quests.title: Names Beyond His Reach
quests.text: Chirr's purse held coins stripped from both armies' dead, and the Undertithe claims every name bought with them. Smother the burning rootmark at {name:r20_anchor_084} and strike the names from the tally-stone at {name:r20_anchor_077} in Gravesalt Escarpment. Without those names to secure the debt, its unpaid balance will draw the collector to the stone. Report to the Warmaster at {name:pvp_fortress_accord}; we have freed the names and made ourselves an appointment.

objectives.label: Strike the names from the tally

quests.lesson: Main line, chapter 3 (last turn-in): two uses, at a Skyglass clash site and at Tombroad Ambush, then back to the Warmaster.

quests.title: Group: Beneath the Waiting Coils
quests.text: {name:glass_throat_serpent} has fattened among the scorched branches of the {name:front_skyglass_canopy/high_canopy}, {dir_from_giver:glass_throat_serpent}. Chirr is dead, but our watchers still cannot cross beneath those coils. Gather a group and slay the elite serpent; freeing a forest includes making room for someone to walk through it.
quests.lesson: Optional group elite; the route reaches 60 without it.

quests.title: Bounty: Eyes Beyond the Lanterns
quests.text: When the lanterns are lit, Gloom Panthers begin their hunt in the {name:front_skyglass_canopy/high_canopy}. Bring down five there after dark, and I will pay a bounty so our watchers can make their rounds. You may accept the bounty again twenty-five minutes after each turn-in. The forest has time to spare; those walking home tonight do not.
quests.lesson: Repeatable hunting bounty, upper Skyglass by night.
